$schema_note: Design tokens of Felix Schramm's personal CI. Derived from the cover letter template and CV (Century Gothic, forest green rule #2E5A2E, grey #666666). Categorical palettes validated for colour-vision deficiency (protan/deutan, OKLab Delta E) and contrast.

meta.name: Felix Schramm CI
meta.default_mode_note: Mode used by charts unless they say otherwise. Light values stay available, e.g. for print.

font_family.note: Century Gothic is a licensed Monotype font (ships with MS Office). For Streamlit Cloud and the web use Questrial from Google Fonts, it is the closest free geometric match.

letter_spacing.note: Section labels in caps (PROFIL, ERFAHRUNG) as in the CV.

typography.numbers: tabular-nums for tables and axis ticks, proportional for hero figures

copper.role: sparing accent: call-outs, a single highlighted value

categorical.note: Assign in this fixed order, never cycled. Max 7 series; beyond that fold into 'Andere'. Scatter/choropleth/small multiples: max 3 slots. Light slots 3, 4, 5, 7 are below 3:1 on the surface, so always add direct labels or a table view.

validation.light: adjacent CVD Delta E >= 14.5, normal vision >= 16.1, surface #FBFBF8
validation.dark: adjacent CVD Delta E >= 10.0, normal vision >= 18.5, all >= 3:1 on #161A17

sequential.note: One hue, light to dark. Use for volume heatmaps, choropleths, density.

diverging.note: Diverging value scale: red for negative values, grey at zero, green for positive values. Anchors match stock_treemap: #B3261E / #5F6368 / #188038. Saturation encodes magnitude. Always show signed values; never rely on red/green alone.
diverging.label: #FFFFFF

finance.note: Up/down follows the market convention (green/red) but is never colour-only: use filled vs hollow candles, triangle icons and signed numbers.

accessible_alternative.note: Optional switch for colour-blind viewers: blue up / copper down, Delta E >= 21 under protan/deutan.

moving_averages.note: Price line stays ink, indicators recede.

status.note: Reserved for states (pipeline healthy, lag, failed). Never used as a series colour; always with icon + label.

chart.legend: top left, no frame; plus direct end labels for <= 4 series
chart.dual_axis: never; index to 100 or use two stacked panels instead
